environment.description: Same Ktor service on ECS Fargate, but origin is fronted by CloudFront distribution d-XXXX with Origin Access Control (OAC) configured. The ALB has a custom header validation rule: requests must include header 'X-Origin-Verify' with a rotating secret value (synced via Secrets Manager automatic rotation every 4 hours). ALB listener rule priority 1 returns 403 for any request missing the correct X-Origin-Verify value. CloudFront distribution has a Behavior configured with Viewer Protocol Policy: HTTPS Only, and a CloudFront Function at viewer-request stage that strips and re-signs the 'X-Service-Token' header using a KMS-backed HMAC — only tokens signed by the internal auth service's KMS key (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/mrk-abc123) pass validation. The CloudFront Function also enforces that POST requests to /api/v1/users/*/role are restricted to signed URLs with a custom policy requiring the caller's IAM principal ARN to match 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RoleManagementService'. Unsigned or incorrectly-signed POST requests to the role endpoint receive a 403 from CloudFront before reaching origin. The signed URL policy uses a canned policy with DateLessThan constraint (5-minute TTL) and IpAddress condition restricting to the internal VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16.

config.alb_rule: Priority 1: deny if X-Origin-Verify != current secret
config.cloudfront_function: viewer-request stage, strips X-Service-Token, re-signs via KMS HMAC
